about: Red Deer County is a municipal district in central Alberta surrounding—but separate from—the City of Red Deer. Hamlets such as Springbrook, Gasoline Alley edges, Elnora approaches, and farm communities sit among parkland fields along Highways 2 and 11. It is a rural municipality, not the city itself. About 20,000 people live in Red Deer County.
